method: Independent raw-derived context statistics sealed in /tmp before reading each author analysis; independent official gold, actual-token serialization, prefix/query reachable graph and layer-consumption verification. Author interval implementation not called. Context bootstrap 10000 seed910; independent 20000 seed124012 is a robustness diagnostic, not a replacement readout.
boundaries: both is the mean of 2 worlds x 2 requested Actors x 8 queries, not joint success
F/R effects are graph access operations with live descendant states and unmatched edge counts/attention mass, not fixed-vector pure-content effects
Source roster is label-free name context, not an identified binding ID or a complete entity-property binding test
Cross-source private demo information is isolated at every layer; query can read both private caches and mix information during its own computation
No-roster native/independent/instruction/single are functional references with different positions; use roster-matched paired phase differences for formation/reading claims
same/opposite means private code index mapping; A no/yes and B pass/flag always have disjoint literal vocabularies
SST0/4 official gold, controlled private conventions, two material splits and fresh aliases; pretraining exposure not excluded; new E124 contexts are not a new benchmark
No old C21-C23 evidence or status is automatically raised/lowered by this experiment; all positive/zero/negative rows retained
